controls.name: C1_corpus_is_the_S36_one
controls.must_fire_because: the cutover must be judged on the corpus that found the defect, not a fresh one
controls.can_fail_because: a different key file, PREFIX_LEN or JOBS would change the job count away from S36's 37
controls.null_must_contain: a job count that is not 37

controls.name: C2_pre_module_is_the_replaced_one
controls.must_fire_because: F3 must compare against the EXACT version replaced, read from git
controls.can_fail_because: a pre module missing verify_completeness, or one that already carries the v3 marker, is the wrong artifact
controls.null_must_contain: a pre-cutover module that already has path_prefix

controls.name: C3_live_module_is_live
controls.must_fire_because: every arm must run the module this cutover edited, not S20's frozen pin
controls.can_fail_because: sys.path order alone decides this, and 5 of 12 consumers get the pin instead
controls.null_must_contain: a LIVE handle resolving to w2_head

falsifiers.name: F1_cutover_is_not_free
falsifiers.can_fail_because: honest accepted != 37 or replay rejected != 37 through the LIVE module
falsifiers.null_must_contain: an honest proof the lifted verifier rejects
falsifiers.refutes: that the lifted verifier keeps S36's measured behaviour
falsifiers.fires_when: honest accepted != 37 or replay rejected != 37 through the LIVE module
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F2_a_consumer_changed
falsifiers.can_fail_because: any consumer's recorded verdict differs before vs after the lift
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a consumer row differing across the two runs
falsifiers.refutes: that the cutover is transparent to every consumer
falsifiers.fires_when: any consumer's recorded verdict differs before vs after the lift
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F3_old_was_not_weaker
falsifiers.can_fail_because: no proof exists that the pre-cutover verifier accepts and the lifted one rejects
falsifiers.null_must_contain: zero replay proofs accepted by the pre module
falsifiers.refutes: that the version bump removes a real soundness hole
falsifiers.fires_when: no proof exists that the pre-cutover verifier accepts and the lifted one rejects
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifier: the lifted verifier rejects an honest proof, a consumer changes verdict, or the old verifier was already sound
